preconditions.description: The length of the ciphered text t is between 1 and 10,000.
The ciphered text t consists of lowercase English letters only.
The number of words m is between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(wi) <= 1000 for wi in words)
preconditions.description: Each word wi has a length between 1 and 1,000.
The total length of all words does not exceed 1,000,000.

postconditions.expression: all(word.lower() in words for word in original_sentence.split())

The ciphered version of the original sentence matches the given ciphered text t.
